summary: Tested COC PDF upload/download feature (admin upload, dealer download, email attachment). Backend: 9 passed, 1 skipped (non-owner dealer test - no second approved dealer + reset-password endpoint unavailable). Frontend: admin /admin/coc-orders shows amber COC PDF section with Upload/Vervangen label and Download button, filename 'test_coc.pdf' rendered correctly; uploading a new PDF via hidden file input (data-testid=coc-pdf-upload-{id}) refreshes UI and shows new filename. Dealer /dealer/orders shows purple 'Download COC/CVO PDF' button (data-testid=coc-pdf-dealer-download-{id}) visible and clickable for the owning dealer. Status update to 'sent_to_dealer' returns 200 and backend logs confirm 'Email sent to zoektest@dealer.nl' (email attachment path executes without error).

integration_issues.issue: Pre-existing 403 AxiosError on secondary fetch (known from iteration_29). Does not affect COC PDF flow - main orders fetch works and dealer download button renders correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/orders.py upload_coc_pdf: extension check happens AFTER reading full file content into memory. For large non-PDF uploads this wastes memory. Suggest validating file.filename extension and/or content_type BEFORE reading the body (or at least before saving). Not a blocker since 20MB size cap exists.

routers/orders.py upload_coc_pdf: file is saved with fixed name '{order_id}.pdf' so re-uploads silently overwrite previous PDFs. Acceptable behavior (Vervangen button in UI matches this), but no backup/version retained.
routers/orders.py download_coc_pdf: properly checks admin OR owning dealer authorization via user[role] and dealer_id. Good.
routers/orders.py update_coc_status: send_email_with_attachment wrapped in try/except and falls back to send_email when no pdf_path - robust. Good.
OrderWithMotorcycle schema correctly includes coc_pdf_filename + coc_pdf_uploaded_at (Optional). Good.
CocOrders.js uses consistent data-testid naming (coc-pdf-section-{id}, coc-pdf-upload-{id}, coc-pdf-upload-label-{id}, coc-pdf-download-{id}). Good.
DealerOrders.js only renders download button when coc_pdf_filename is present - correct conditional.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 executed passed, 1 skipped due to no second dealer)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin upload+download+filename render + dealer download button verified)
